name: procedural-runtime-gate3-slice-v1
purpose: Correctness and resource-bound protocol for the smallest source-driven procedural active-working-set runtime slice. This is not the material 200k Gate-3 performance run.

public_seam.python_role: Validate and marshal one batch per advance; no per-cell or per-step simulation.
public_seam.instance_concurrency: Every public advance, snapshot, and idempotent close operation is serialized by one per-instance reentrant lock in both adapters.
public_seam.raw_ffi_lifetime: Raw C handles require external lifetime synchronization. A NULL/0 destination pair explicitly omits that output; every supplied destination capacity is validated before any destination write.

gid.source_gid_semantics: Configured source-cell identity used for event provenance and deterministic ordering; no sentinel is defined.

determinism.spike_expansion_order: ascending source gid, then ascending edge slot
determinism.duplicate_event_keys: Duplicate canonical keys in a submitted input-event batch or the already queued frontier are rejected before native simulation-state mutation; runtime remains unpoisoned.
determinism.floating_point_rule: No reassociation, tolerance, or analytic catch-up. Signed zero is canonicalized to positive zero at every event/state write boundary in both adapters.

residency.activation: A due nonzero event materializes its target immediately before that step's GLIF5 update.
residency.eviction: After a real fixed-step update, evict only if all eight mutable fields are bitwise canonical positive zero/integer zero.
residency.future_events: A future queued event does not force residency before it is due.
residency.nonzero_tails: Nonzero exponential tails remain resident and updated until exact underflow or cancellation produces canonical zero.
residency.capacity_failure: Resident, event, returned-spike, interval-distinct, bounded-allocation, or spike-generated event-key collision failure is deterministic and fail-stop. Submitted duplicate-input and snapshot-buffer validation remain non-poisoning. No spill, tolerance eviction, dense fallback, or compatibility path exists.
residency.failed_step_commit: The biological step and completed-interval counters remain at the last completed boundary. Bounded in-progress state is deterministic and snapshot-visible; rollback is not claimed.

exactness_gate.comparison: Bit-exact bytes for every cell field, pending event, and spike after every advance.
cases: resident, event, spike, and interval-distinct capacity fail-stop
returned-spike capacity exhaustion before step commit
spike-generated event-key collision after mutation is fail-stop
cross-call duplicate rejection without mutation or poison
all-before-write sparse and dense snapshot capacity validation
collision-heavy native fanout row and widened uint64 fallback arithmetic

required: identical cell-step, generated-edge, and configured-ID-scan counters
no array, loop, mask, owner table, or topology materialization proportional to configured cells
resource_gate.sparse_memory_bound: O(R_capacity + Q_capacity + S_capacity + F + D_capacity), independent of N_configured
resource_gate.sparse_work_bound: Per interval, O(T*R + event sorting/merging + bounded sorted-resident insertion + S*bounded_counter64_row_generation); row membership is set-backed and candidate examinations are at most 129*F+1 per row; never O(N_configured).
resource_gate.allocation_rule: Resident, event, returned-spike, interval-distinct, due/merge, step-spike, and topology-row storage is fallibly reserved during construction and reused without hot-loop growth. In-place unstable sorts are used.
resource_gate.fault_injection: Logical capacity exhaustion and raw usize capacity-overflow creation are tested. Real allocator exhaustion is not safely or practically injected under the process-global allocator.
resource_gate.dense_oracle_exclusion: The explicitly named small dense oracle allocates O(N_small) and is never the production adapter.

accounting.memory: Native runtime struct plus persistent Vec capacities and logical HashMap/HashSet entry capacities at interval end. Reusable scratch is included. Allocator metadata and hash-table control bytes are not introspected; the dense oracle is excluded.

source_binding.framing: humanbrain-procedural-runtime-source-v1: ordered UTF-8 path length/path plus uint64 byte length/raw bytes

timing.material_gate: A separately approved run must retain the research Gate-3 conditions: 200k resident and fully updated cells, exact parity, and greater than 100 end-to-end tokens/s on the same RTX 4070 SUPER.
timing.rule: Correctness/resource tests authorize no speed statement. Timing thresholds cannot be added or weakened after observing a material run.

claims.correctness: The implemented uniform-no-self vertical slice exactly simulates a reported sparse resident/updated subset inside a uint64 procedural address space.
